notes: Product leads: CTO Mei Tan, Head of Product Rajiv Shah. Primary interest: replace current on-prem semantic search w/ lower latency + predictable costs. Quote from CTO: "need canary + rollback plan — can't afford a spike in hallucinations in prod". They ran hosted API PoC first; now moving to Dedicated to get reserved capacity and VPC peering. Team is pragmatic on model choice: prefers open 7B/13B quantized for cost, but will test larger variants for quality-sensitive reranking flows. Legal flagged data residency for EU customers. SE asked about automatic fallback routing across regions and model variants.
use_case_summary: Mid-market SaaS building an in-app AI assistant and site-wide semantic search. Primary flows are mixed chat (low latency, moderate throughput) and embedding-based search (higher throughput for batch indexing). Need deterministic cost for customer billing and predictable tail latency for SLAs.
requirements_list: p50 latency target: <120ms for chat on typical prompts
throughput: sustained 40-60 req/sec during peak indexing windows
canary rollout support with traffic % control and early rollback
fallback routing by model variant (primary -> quantized -> small)
region failover EU <-> NA, with warm standby and automated DNS/route switch
VPC peering + private endpoints, KMS integration for keys
audit logs retained 90 days, SOC2 attestation required
canary_plan: POC will run Dedicated canary: 5% traffic for 48 hours to new model variant (13B quant) with telemetry checks. Metrics: latency p95, error rate, and prompt-level quality score (eval set). Automated rollback trigger if latency p95 increases >30% or quality score drops >5% versus baseline. Fallback routing: on model OOMs or degraded performance, route to compatible quantized/smaller variant in same region; if region degraded, failover to alternate region pool with warm KV cache. SE to validate KV cache seeding during canary.
pricing_notes: Requested Dedicated tier pricing for 2x A100-equivalent reserved pool + burst capacity. Interested in 12-month commit with step-up option. Asked for clear per-token cost delta between hosted and dedicated with batching and quantization enabled; wants example TCO for chat + embeddings workload.
integration_notes: Engineering will deploy an adapter that uses Redwood routing headers to steer traffic. Plan to use route tags: canary=true, region=eu-west-1, model_variant=13B-quant. Need SDK sample for graceful fallback on 429/503 with exponential backoff and immediate reroute to fallback model.
